observable_requests.affirmative_interpretation: The foreground is organized as one joined construction with exactly two principal enclosed loops.

panel_descriptions.neg_0: Two curved sector outlines connect through a central arrangement of small squares, circles, and a zigzag segment, creating additional internal structure.
panel_descriptions.neg_1: Three arms radiate from a crowded junction: two square chains and one long zigzag chain, supplemented by circles and bent strokes.
panel_descriptions.neg_2: Several curved chains of circles, squares, and triangles form a broken rounded construction with multiple inward branches.
panel_descriptions.neg_3: A large beaded loop, a narrow square-chain section, and a small angular loop converge around one crowded junction.
panel_descriptions.neg_4: Two broad beaded and zigzag forms meet at a central square, while a straight diagonal segment divides the right-hand form.
panel_descriptions.neg_5: Three outlined triangular loops overlap at one central crossing.
panel_descriptions.pos_0: A curved wedge-shaped loop and an angular loop meet at a central crossing.
panel_descriptions.pos_1: Two narrow triangular loops join in a slender diagonal arrangement.
panel_descriptions.pos_2: Two angular polygonal loops overlap centrally, producing a lightning-bolt silhouette.
panel_descriptions.pos_3: Two joined loops are traced with sequences of squares, triangles, circles, and zigzags: a larger upper-left loop and a smaller lower-right loop.
panel_descriptions.pos_4: A large curved wedge-shaped loop crosses into a smaller angular loop at the lower right.
panel_descriptions.pos_5: A large inverted triangular loop joins a small tilted quadrilateral loop at one central junction.
